import React, { useState} from 'react'
import {
    Dialog,
    DialogContent,
    DialogDescription,
    DialogHeader,
    DialogTitle,
} from "@/components/ui/dialog"
import { UsersRound } from 'lucide-react'
import './styles/AddNewPerson.scss'

const AddNewPerson = () => {
    const [open, setOpen] = useState(false)

    return (
        <>
            <button className="add-group" type="button" onClick={() => {setOpen(true)}}>
                +  <UsersRound />
            </button>
            <Dialog open={open}>
                <DialogContent>
                    <DialogHeader>
                    <DialogTitle>Add new person</DialogTitle>
                    <DialogDescription>
                        blah blah blah
                    </DialogDescription>
                    </DialogHeader>
                </DialogContent>
            </Dialog>
        </>
    )
}

export default AddNewPerson
